## Orientation

Wave partner is fix-verdict-help-test, which writes only in the affidavit worktree. You write only in /home/andrewyin/orchestra on branch phase/standalone-aff. Edit tests/test_affidavit_check.py only. Do not edit the affidavit trees, the CLI, skills, or .artifacts. Do not call adaptive-artifacts.

Name the test so pytest -k orchestra_subcommand_help selects it. Commit excluding .artifacts with message fix-orchestra-help-tests.

R3: check.py, close_batch.py, aa.py, aa_resolve.py, policy.py, and affidavit.tmux live in ~/orchestra, with the tests that cover them. orchestra check and orchestra close-batch are the commands that write workflow records. They take the arguments aff check and aff close-batch take today.

aff-orchestra-seam: aff is verdict-only; orchestra check and orchestra close-batch own the store client; orchestra imports affidavit.oracle_red and does not import run_verdict.
record.subject: fix-orchestra-help-tests
